summary: Anavex Life Sciences filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, reporting FDA notification that the company may proceed with a planned clinical study under its IND for blarcamesine (ANAVEX 2-73) in Fragile X syndrome, opening a Phase 2a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled dose-ranging trial in adult males. No financial terms, securities, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing condition are disclosed. This is a routine regulatory/clinical milestone current report, not a special situation; watch pipeline execution and future trial data rather than deal mechanics.
